findings.title: classifier deliberately does not cover the de-flaked liveness assertions, so a 30s-bound exhaustion still charges an attempt
`tests/run.sh` and `scripts/ci-local.sh` now discard all output from passing test files, a repo-wide observability loss beyond T019's scope

a waiver satisfied by the exec-bit/env/flaky pool never computes the pin state, so a simultaneously-outstanding stale pin goes unnamed in that round's reason — the very "clears one, walks into the other" case the function's own comment says it avoids
